headline: Commercial agents, taxi drivers and truck drivers | over 49,000 businesses in Lombardy struggling with rising fuel prices
summary: Over 49,000 businesses in Lombardy, including commercial agents, taxi drivers and truck drivers, are struggling with rising fuel prices. The report describes the pressure on firms that depend on road transport.
why: Lombardy is Italy's most industrialised region and an economic hub around Milan. Fuel costs feed directly into transport and service margins across the economy.
